Q: Receive "Error reading input file" when running password decryption in BASH A:

Update

To prove the problem is the ciphertext / password file and not the empty master password

Original answer

I've tested your script, the error occurs because the file exists but contain bad ciphertext / does not match the decryption parameter. When the ciphertext matches, the script execute successfully.

Steps to test

  1. Save your bash script to file test.sh, add 2 lines at the bottom:
MASTER_PASSWORD='super_secret_master_password'
retrieve_password "$MASTER_PASSWORD"
  1. Generate the ciphertext using the exact parameter as the decryption command:
$ echo "test user password" > user.plain
$ openssl enc -e -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -a -iter 10000 \
  -pass "pass:super_secret_master_password" \
  -in user.plain \
  -out ./data/passwords/user
  1. Run the script
$ sh test.sh 
Please enter your account name: user
test user password
Please press Enter when done viewing ...

Q: Gradle Package does not exist A:

How dependency mapped

  1. dependencies mapped with testCompile will be compiled with src/test/java classes
  2. dependencies mapped with compile will be compiled with src/main/java classes

Issue with the gradle config

Few dependencies are mapped as testCompile but it could be referenced in production code src/main/java.

testCompile group: 'org.apache.commons', name: 'commons-lang3', version: '3.3.2'

Should be 

compile group: 'org.apache.commons', name: 'commons-lang3', version: '3.3.2'

Q: How Can I Fix the Microsoft Visual Studio Error: Package Did Not Load Correctly A:
  1. Find ComponentModelCache folder
  2. Delete Microsoft.VisualStudio.Default.cache
  3. Restart Visual Studio

Enjoy using Visual Studio.
